versions.content: Range ETHSWT_PORT_MIRRORING_ CONFIGURATION_NOT_ SUPPORTED 0x02 port mirroring configuration is not supported by Ethernet switch driver or by the Ethernet switch hardware Description Overlayed return value of Std_ReturnType for Ethernet switch driver API EthSwt_WritePortMirror Configuration, if the port mirroring configuration is not supported by Ethernet switch driver or by the Ethernet switch hardware (e.g. the configured mirrored traffic direction (see SWS_EthSwt_91017 "TrafficDirectionIngressBitMask" and "TrafficDirectionEgressBitMask") for ingress and egress traffic of the same port is not supported, or the addressed Ethernet switch ports within the port mirror configuration are not accessible by the Ethernet switch driver) Available via Eth_GeneralTypes.h
